item.description:
Astronomical 0.2.71
## Fixed
- Paged prefill no longer stalls at zero progress on large sparse models. Expert-layer seating now respects the composed memory budget, capacity recovery releases whole expert tables in a single cycle, and every prompt-processing attempt is logged. A workload that previously stalled silently for 91 seconds now completes prefill in about 7 seconds. - The effective memory ceiling is now proven against the operating system's graphics-memory wired policy at worker startup. Under the default policy the ceiling is composed conservatively, the machine verifies it by wiring it, and any clamp is logged and reported. Decode throughput no longer collapses when a configured ceiling exceeds what the machine can actually wire. - Image attachments advertised as WebP now decode through the WebP path instead of failing.
## Added
- `repetition_penalty` joins the per-model generation defaults. Models can ship their tested default, and an explicit request value still takes precedence.
## Compatibility
- Configuration, prompt caches, and the local API remain compatible with 0.2.70. No migration is required, and existing user state is preserved. - Effective memory ceilings can be lower than in 0.2.70 when the operating system cannot support the previously composed ceiling; the startup log states the verified value.
## Distribution
- The app is Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and stapled. The DMG and the Sparkle update feed are signed, and the published bytes are digest-verified against the release manifest before the feed activates.
